flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx (empty), utils/data/LinkData.tsx (Work Items menu commented out), utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts, utils/mapping/NoticeUPL.ts (allocated_to hard-coded), utils/models/Fapi.d.ts (workitemallocation type); ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (placeholder). No OIC-to-OIC routing code in the six repos
note: Status sheet: Requirement given - Gen flow. There is no feature to re-route a work item to another OIC: no dashboard, OIC picker, allocation storage or per-user query. Only traces: the resource name workitemallocation in a TypeScript type and a placeholder comment about the ocms_work_item_allocation table. Several synonyms were tried in the UI and both API tiers. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code. Do not claim; routing a work item between OICs is not built.

steps.step: The officer opens a work item routed to them on the dashboard
steps.detail: The Work Items menu is commented out (LinkData.tsx:398), utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts:1-12 only holds the path '/work-item' with no Route in App.tsx, and the dashboard is empty (Dashboard.tsx:26-29).

steps.step: The officer picks another OIC as the routing target
steps.detail: There is no OIC picker. The only allocated_to value in the UI is the logged-in user, written '//! Hard code' (NoticeUPL.ts:194). Synonyms reassign, assign, forward, transfer, route were tried in ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi: no OIC-to-OIC routing code.

steps.step: The work item allocation is saved for the selected OIC
steps.detail: The resource name 'workitemallocation' is only registered as a type (Fapi.d.ts:264-266) with no caller in the UI. In the backend the ocms_work_item_allocation table appears only in a placeholder comment (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2907-2912); no entity, repository or controller exists.

steps.step: The work item appears on the selected OIC's dashboard
steps.detail: The dashboard is empty (Dashboard.tsx:26-29); there is no per-user work item query.
